rationale: Single self-executing command: revoke EO 1038 (Fire Island, Alaska moose preserve). The command was performed by its own words when signed by President Harding on 1921-03-26 (date per tracker/ORDERS.csv; OCR of the scan reads 'March 2 6, I92x'), corroborated by the held Wikisource EO 1038 page 'Revoked by Executive Order 3421, March 26, 1921'. Exhausted by performance; the surviving consequence (EO 1038 revoked) is not a continuing command. Wikisource also notes EO 4131 of 1925-01-22 re-established the reserve; that is a separate later act and does not revive 3421. OCR scan page check still needed.
